error_chain.expected_solution: Error propagation chain: (1) Kafka consumer poll() encounters a record with unexpected schema, KafkaConsumer throws SerializationException during deserialization → (2) SerializationException is thrown before the record reaches Spring Kafka's MessageListener, so it occurs at the poll level in KafkaMessageListenerContainer → (3) KafkaMessageListenerContainer catches the SerializationException in its ListenerConsumer.run() loop but it bypasses the configured ErrorHandler because no ConsumerRecord exists to pass to it → (4) DeadLetterPublishingRecoverer requires a ConsumerRecord to publish to the DLT, but deserialization failure means no record was created → (5) The correct fix is wrapping the deserializer with ErrorHandlingDeserializer which catches the exception and creates a ConsumerRecord with the error in headers.
